caseName: New Jersey v. New York, Susquehanna & Western Railroad
caseNameFull: New Jersey v. New York, Susquehanna & Western Railroad Co.
attorneys: Clarence M. Mulholland, Edward J. Hickey, Jr. and James L. Highsaw, Jr. on the motion., Vincent P. Biunno for appellee, in opposition.
